summary: Switches between related panels in the same context without changing page.
whenToUse: Alternative views of the same object (overview, activity, settings).
Parallel content that users do not need to compare at the same time.
whenNotToUse: Navigation between pages with different URLs: use NavigationMenu or links.
Filters or view switching: use ToggleGroup.

props.name: keyboardActivation
props.description: Manual: arrow keys only move focus, Enter/Space activate.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Tabs take up the full width.

props.name: Tab: icon / badge
props.description: Decorative icon and trailing content (e.g. Badge).

props.name: Tab: isDisabled
props.description: Non-selectable tab, skipped by the arrow keys.

inherits: Props of react-aria-components Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel.

keyboard.action: Enters the TabList on the selected tab, then moves to the panel.
Previous/next tab; in RTL the direction is reversed.

accessibility: APG Tabs pattern: tablist, tab with aria-selected, tabpanel with aria-labelledby.
The TabList needs an aria-label if there is no visible heading.
The panel is focusable only if it contains no interactive elements.
responsive: The TabList scrolls horizontally with local overflow: no page-level scrolling.
On mobile, prefer the line variant with short labels.
customization: Indicator: text.link color; pill: surface.muted and surface.raised.
commonMistakes: Using Tabs as page navigation with URLs: use links with aria-current.
Mismatched ids between Tab and TabPanel.
